title: German-Style Bean Gratin
description: A hearty German-inspired side dish perfect for accompanying sausages or schnitzel. The creamy topping adds a rich and comforting element to the dish.
instructions: Trim the ends of the long beans and cut them into 1-inch pieces.
In a large skillet, sauté the long beans in a little bit of oil until tender.
In a separate bowl, mix together the kissed cream, argentinian cheese, and chinese five-spice powder.
Transfer the cooked long beans to a baking dish and top with the creamy mixture.
Sprinkle the grated gratin on top of the creamy mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
